name: smarter-faster-better-mcp
description: Blazing fast AST-based MCP code search using OXC with optional Tree-sitter polyglot parsing
author: Igor Haiduk

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.js --target node --format esm --packages=external && bun build src/bin/test-scout.ts --outdir dist/bin --target node --format esm --packages=external
scripts.prepack: npm run check && npm run build
scripts.scout: npm run build --silent && node dist/bin/test-scout.js cache
scripts.scout:summary: npm run build --silent && node dist/bin/test-scout.js cache --summary
